findings.message: `42` is a '42', accepted here as the class 'Token', and it is not an instance of that class. tsc compares classes by shape, and it compares a method's parameters in both directions, so a method that takes only a narrower type passes as one that takes any of the wider type, and fails at runtime when it gets one. In Adamic a class type means an instance of that class. Pass an instance of 'Token', or type the slot as an interface whose members are written property-style (`readonly admit: (animal: Animal) => string`), which tsc checks strictly.
